rows.ARS:
Orange blend Miniature.
Registration name: SAVaden
Exhibition name: Denver's Dream™
rows.Origin:
Bred by F. Harmon Saville (1924-1997) (United States, before 1994).
Introduced in United States by Nor' East Miniature Roses in 1996 as 'Denver's Dream'.
rows.Bloom: Copper - orange, red reverse. None / no fragrance. 15 to 25 petals. Average diameter 2". Medium-large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, rounded, upright. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 30" (60 to 75cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 4b through 10b. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant.
